details.description: Kimi K2.5 is Moonshot AI's open-weight, natively multimodal mixture-of-experts chat model, with 1 trillion total parameters and 32 billion active per token, built via continual pretraining on roughly 15 trillion mixed visual and text tokens atop Kimi K2 Base. It takes text and image input, offers an instant mode and an extended thinking mode, and adds an 'Agent Swarm' feature that can split a task across up to 100 self-orchestrated sub-agents. Released January 29, 2026 under a Modified MIT License; Moonshot's own newer Kimi K2.6 (April 2026) already scores higher on several agentic benchmarks.
advantages: Scores 78.5 on MMMU-Pro, a multimodal reasoning benchmark.
Agent Swarm mode can decompose a task and run up to 100 self-orchestrated sub-agents in parallel.
disadvantages: Superseded within Moonshot's own lineup by Kimi K2.6 (released April 2026), which scores 58.6 vs. K2.5's 50.7 on SWE-Bench Pro and leads Humanity's Last Exam with tools at 54.0.
use_cases: Agentic coding from visual specifications such as UI designs.
Multi-step tool calling with interleaved thinking for autonomous tasks.
Cross-modal reasoning over mixed image-and-text input.
Large multi-agent workflows via Agent Swarm orchestration.

sources.title: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K2.6 with Long-Horizon Coding, Agent Swarm Scaling to 300 Sub-Agents and 4,000 Coordinated Steps

notes: Facts list modality as image_input + text only (no video); Moonshot's own docs describe a 'video chat' feature as experimental and limited to the official API rather than a core open-weight capability, so it isn't claimed here. The 256K context window (262,144) matches facts exactly. No explicit natural-language list found, so languages is left empty.
